title: Delphi record_research input
description: The input of the MCP tool `record_research` (specs/113 section 2; crates/delphi-engine/src/host_research.rs `input_schema`, which the tool declares; the docs test holds the two equal). A host hands over research it did with its own tools. Everything in it is data from the host: it is stored noted and not validated, and what the host says about trust, status or privacy is not read. Delphi fetches a public web source itself and looks for each quote; a private source, or one of kind internal, file or person, is never fetched.

answer.description: Your answer, as Markdown, at most 24 KiB.

locator.description: A URL, or a description of a source with no public address.

private.description: True for anything not public: Delphi then never fetches it and keeps only its locator, title and date.

pictures.description: Addresses (https) of pictures on this page worth keeping. Delphi keeps one only if the page it reads shows it and its own rules allow it (trusted host, a description, a licence that allows keeping it); you cannot hand over a picture.

quote.description: The exact words of the source that support it.

source.description: The index of its source in `sources`, counting from 0.

where.description: Where you searched (the web, a connector, a folder).

gaps.description: What you looked for and did not find.

topic_id.description: A research topic id Delphi gave you, to add this as a new run of it.

subject.description: What the research is about, as a name (a concept such as `Web Bot Auth`, not a question): the title of its topic page. Taken only if it shares a word with the question or a heading of your answer; otherwise Delphi makes the title from the question.
